layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Tiny dinosaur size comparison
features: A massive, towering clay figure of a child in a red jumpsuit, appearing like a giant
At the child's feet stands a tiny, yellow clay Compsognathus dinosaur
The dinosaur is extremely small, only reaching the child's ankle
The child is looking down at the tiny dinosaur with a friendly expression
Clean, minimalist clay sculpts with smooth surfaces and gentle rounded edges
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic wide shot on a seamless off-white studio background. The composition mirrors the giant sauropod image, but this time the child is the giant and the dinosaur is the tiny subject. No text.
